scenario: Entry still exists but the group owning its selected options was deleted: selections come back as an empty array
notes: DELETE /api/groups/{id} cascades: group_options has FOREIGN KEY (group_id) REFERENCES groups ON DELETE CASCADE and entry_selections cascades from group_options (api/database_schema.py). After deleting the 'Emotions' group, the entry recorded in get-mood-selections__happy.json returns [] instead of its two options.
